hints.title: Prefix Invariance
hints.text: Deleting characters only from the right end leaves some common prefix intact in all three strings.

hints.title: Common Prefix Length
hints.text: Find the length L of the longest common prefix shared by s1, s2, and s3.

hints.title: Deletion Counting
hints.text: If L equals 0, the strings cannot be made equal. Otherwise, total deletions equal len(s1) + len(s2) + len(s3) - 3 * L.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass comparing characters at index i across the three strings.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Examining suffixes or deletions individually is unnecessary.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Identify longest common prefix as the sole target substring.
